provider_duration_rule: Duration enum "3"-"15" (default "5"); per-shot multi_prompt duration enum 1-15. This production uses one prompt per clip (multi_prompt is refused by the provider contract) and duration "6" for every shot.
segmentation_note: Provider duration limits are handled through shot segmentation, not by changing the story: SC3 and SC6 are each two 6-second shots because one shot cannot hold two different camera framings / movements.

shots.justification: 6 s: the narration line needs 5.8 s, and the strike-cup-light movement needs the full clip; a shorter clip would cut the lighting action.
6 s: the narration line needs 5.2 s, and the walk needs several full strides to read as movement, not a pose.

6 s: the narration line needs 4.1 s; the remaining time is the silent watching beat — the lantern drifting while she holds her breath — which is the point of the shot.

6 s: the narration line needs 4.5 s; the unfold and the first rain splashes need the full clip.

6 s: the narration line needs 5.2 s, and the release plus the first rise need the full clip to close the film.

audio_timeline_note: Planned narration 39.3 s + 7 x 0.5 s pauses + 1.0 s lead-in + 1.5 s tail-out = 45.3 s inside 48 s of video; the remaining ~2.7 s is ambient (river, rain, lantern glow, music). The final schedule is computed from MEASURED narration durations at assembly time.
